sn35.155:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.155:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, dhammakathiko hotīti?
sn35.155:2.1: cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya;
sn35.155:2.2: cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti, dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya;
sn35.155:2.3: cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya; sotassa …pe… ghānassa …pe…
sn35.155:2.5: manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya;
sn35.155:2.6: manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti, dhammānudhammappaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya;
sn35.155:2.7: manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādāvimutto hoti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃvacanāyāti.
